lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Hi, I'm Anna, the project manager for the Brightside portal.

lines.speaker: mark
lines.text: And I'm Mark, I'm handling the backend.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Great. Let's go through what's left before the client launch.

lines.speaker: mark
lines.text: Sure. First, the client is still waiting for our API documentation.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Right. Mark, can you send them the API docs by Wednesday?

lines.speaker: mark
lines.text: Yes, I'll send the API docs by Wednesday.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Perfect, thanks.

lines.speaker: mark
lines.text: Also, we could add a dark mode while we're at it. Users keep asking for it.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Actually, that's a good idea. Mark, can you take it by Friday?

lines.speaker: mark
lines.text: Sure, I'll do the dark mode by Friday.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Next, the staging demo. Can you have it ready by Thursday?

lines.speaker: mark
lines.text: Thursday works.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: And I'll book a meeting room for the client workshop.

lines.speaker: mark
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: One more thing. The privacy policy page has to be updated before launch.

lines.speaker: mark
lines.text: Yes, that definitely needs to happen.

lines.speaker: mark
lines.text: Oh, and do we know if the client needs single sign-on?

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: No idea yet. Nobody has asked them.

lines.speaker: mark
lines.text: Actually, about the staging demo. Thursday is too tight because of the database migration. Can we say Monday instead?

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Okay, let's make it Monday.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: And I just got a message from the client. They want to run the workshop online, so I won't book the meeting room after all.

lines.speaker: mark
lines.text: Makes sense.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Great, I think that's everything. Thanks, Mark.

lines.speaker: mark
lines.text: Thanks, Anna. Talk soon.
